citation: Sexual orientation by age and sex: CDC/NCHS National Health Interview Survey 2024, public-use sample adult file (ORIENT_A, weighted by WTFA_A), shares among adults who answered; computed by OPUS-PEOPLE's research helper (data/research/people/orientation-2026.json). 'Something else' and 'don't know' are counted with straight for partnering. Checks: same-sex couples are 1.26% of married and 5.66% of unmarried couple households (Census ACS 2023, same-sex couples Table 2); 86.5% of partnered bisexual adults have a different-sex partner (NHIS 2024; Pew 2019: 88%).
